Import.Title: Import a table

RulebookTables.Title: Tables from your rulebook
RulebookTables.Reading: Reading the tables in your rulebook…

RulebookTables.Intro: These are the tables read from your copy of the book. Open one to check or correct its rows (one per line, as the table importer reads them), untick any you do not want, then build. They become world roll tables in the From your rulebook folder; the system rolls on Careers, Spells, Names, Surnames and Reaction at once. A table you made or edited yourself is never overwritten.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Base Knavery
Welcome.Unofficial: Base Knavery is an unofficial, fan-made game system for Foundry VTT, compatible with Knave: Second Edition. It is not a Questing Beast LLC product and is not approved or endorsed by them. It ships none of the book's text or art: you play with your own copy of the rules, and its tables start empty for you to fill. The character traits, reaction, starting gear and a spell list come from Knave's first edition, which is free to share, until your own book replaces them.
Welcome.ChooseRulebook: Choose your rulebook PDF from this computer
Welcome.NoRulebook: This world has no rulebook yet. Choose your copy of the Knave 2e PDF to read it inside Foundry; it is uploaded to this server only.
Welcome.ShowOnStart: Show after each update, and until a rulebook is chosen
